correctness.rationale: For A=B^T B rank-two PSD, exact untruncated Nyström recovery iff the m projected independent sign columns B eps span R², using W(W^TW)^dag W^T projector identity. A single-sign image has zero mass z<=1/4 by two independent columns; each projective line L has total mass z+p_L<=1/2 by nontrivial linear-form anti-concentration. Set c=1/2-z, total nonzero masses=2c+z and each <=c, z<=c. Convex projective occupancy is bounded by masses (c,c,z), giving F_m<=2^(1-m)+(2^m-2)z^m<=3*2^(-m)-2*4^(-m). n=3 witness B=[[1,1,0],[1,0,1]] has z=p_1=p_2=p_3=1/4 and saturates, with zero padding for n>3; n=2 every invertible B sends four signs into two equiprobable projective lines, yielding 2^(1-m). Independent exact m=2,3,4 values 5/8,11/32,23/128 corroborate.
